title: THE UNDERCROFT ANSWERS IN THE HUD VOICE
why: His answer 48 (2026-10-12): use wording consistent with a AAA game in all instances. The answer line that pops up under the windows in the Undercroft still spoke in whole explaining sentences while the raid already speaks in short caps callouts. About thirty of those lines (the stash, the backpack, the tactical belt, the bench, contracts, rewards, hires, trades and saving) now read like the raid: BACKPACK FULL, NOTHING TO SELL, CONTRACT PAID, NOBODY IS HIRED, ALREADY EQUIPPED. Your own wording, the vendor lines and the drink lines are untouched.
now: The Undercroft answer line now speaks in short caps callouts, like the raid HUD.
